description: RECOLOR tier copycats: each is one public ARC-AGI-3 game with rules, maps, sprites, HUD and winning line unchanged; only the displayed colours are permuted (a bijection that moves every shown colour). Tests colour generalisation alone. verified=true means the original's line wins level by level in the engine and through arc_agi's offline loader, and every frame equals the original's frame with the palette applied.
review_rule: A copy is not a yardstick until a human (the Boss or Son) has played it and set reviewed to true. verified only means the stored line wins in the engine and the loader; it says nothing about whether the copy is fair, readable or as hard as the original.
id_rule: original id with second letter -> 'r'; 'q' where the second letter already is 'r' (ar25, tr87)
solutions: withheld on purpose; the builder replays the originals' recorded lines

games.kept: Everything that decides play: rule code, level maps, sprite shapes, HUD, tile size, action set, budgets, and the original's own winning line, level by level.
games.changed: Displayed colours only: a fixed permutation of the 16 ARC colours that moves every colour the game shows and keeps them all distinct.
games.not_changed: Sprites were not redrawn and the HUD was not moved: several games' rules read sprite pixels, so redrawing is a per-game job, and this tier is meant to test colour alone.
games.usage: TEST ONLY -- NEVER TRAIN. Held-out evaluation copy of a held-out game.
games.solution_file: withheld: it would be the held-out original's own winning line
